question: Does the sentence "Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers from the pepper patch" contain exactly 13 occurrences of the letter 'p' (ignoring case)?

claims.text: The sentence contains exactly 13 occurrences of the letter 'p' ignoring case.
The words a, of, from, and the contain no 'p's.
The word-by-word count gives exactly 13 and no word was left out.
A quick count could easily be off and come out at 12 or 14 because of repeated 'p's.
Because the question asks for exactly 13, any miscount would change the answer.
The systematic count settles the matter at 13.
